verdict_scheme.CONSISTENT_CORRECT: both agree and the shared answer is right
verdict_scheme.CONSISTENT_WRONG: both agree and the shared answer is wrong -- NOT a contradiction
verdict_scheme.DIVERGENT_COMPATIBLE: one says more, nothing denied -- NOT a contradiction
verdict_scheme.CONTRADICTORY: the two answers cannot both be true -- THE TARGET
verdict_scheme.SCOPE_INCONSISTENT: one answered, one refused as out of scope -- reported separately
verdict_scheme.UNADJUDICABLE: one or both replies too vague to place

population_caveat: MEASURED ON 24 AUTHORED PAIRS, not a corpus-wide estimate and never to be cited as one. The pairs were written to probe phrasing-dependence, 6 each across covered_fact / gap / compute / boundary, and two of them (cp_09, cp_12) deliberately repeat shapes whose 2026-09-05 outcome was already known -- one inconsistent, one consistent -- so the corpus is not composed only of rows selected for having failed. WHY THIS POPULATION: no other corpus in this repo can answer the question at all, because every one of them is one-phrasing-per-question by construction and therefore cannot detect phrasing-dependence however large it grows (R22: name the population, and say why it is where the decision applies).
axis_separation: CONSISTENT_WRONG is NOT counted as a contradiction: two answers that agree and are both wrong are a CORRECTNESS failure, which every other corpus here already measures, and folding it in would inflate this headline with the wrong defect. SCOPE_INCONSISTENT is reported alongside and never summed in silently. The asymmetry annotation is a THIRD thing and is likewise never summed in silently.

if_asymmetry_counted_as_instability.note: Offered so the reader can take either view explicitly. It is NOT the headline, because these pairs are not contradictions under the frozen scheme.

scheme_hole.shape: ASYMMETRIC ACTIONABILITY -- one member commits to a figure or an authority, the other hedges or answers a different question. Nothing is denied, so the strict test files it under DIVERGENT_COMPATIBLE, a bucket whose name claims benign completeness variance.
scheme_hole.why_not_fixed_here: Adding a seventh verdict after reading the replies would make the scheme a function of its own data -- the one property freezing it before the run exists to protect.
scheme_hole.clearest_instance: cp_17 -- A computes a presumptive tax bill of TZS 106,000 (itself wrong; the band gives 250,000), B never mentions presumptive tax at all and leaves the impression nothing is owed. Not a formal contradiction. A user cannot act on both.
scheme_hole.recommendation: Freeze a seventh verdict for this shape BEFORE the next paired corpus is measured. It now has 4 observed instances.

verdicts.topic_axis: whether the service levy has a statutory maximum, and what it is
verdicts.reasoning: A: 'Hakuna kiwango cha juu kilichowekwa kwenye sheria. Ni kikomo cha CHINI tu cha asilimia 0.3' -- there is NO maximum in law, 0.3% is only a FLOOR. B: 'kiwango cha juu kabisa kinachoruhusiwa ni asilimia 0.3' -- the maximum allowed is 0.3%. These cannot both be true. B is correct; A inverts the statute's central distinction and is additionally self-contradictory in one sentence (denies a ceiling, then calls 0.3% a 'cap'). A CONTRADICTION ON A COVERED FACT, which is the finding that breaks the prior gaps-only picture.
verdicts.correctness_basis: locked_facts council_service_levy_is_a_cap_not_a_rate; Cap 290 s.7(1)(u) 'at the rate not exceeding 0.3 percent'

The frozen scheme names 'two different named authorities for one function' as CONTRADICTORY, and both assertions are in the BODY, so RULE 2 does not rescue it. B is additionally self-inconsistent: body says zimamoto, verify line says OSHA. Genuine coverage gap -- no fire-safety fact exists in locked_facts, so both are fabricating the authority.

verdicts.topic_axis: who calibrates shop scales, and how often
verdicts.reasoning: A commits to an authority -- 'Ofisi ya Viwanda na Biashara (OVB)', with domain ovb.go.tz -- and answers no frequency. Counting referral lines as assertions would make this CONTRADICTORY and move the headline from 4/24 to 5/24. Rule stated and applied uniformly; the sensitivity is reported rather than buried. verdicts.reasoning: A: added to business income and taxed at ordinary rates. B: a 5% withholding is collected on M-Pesa/Tigo Pesa receipts. Withholding and inclusion in income routinely coexist, and nothing in A formally denies a withholding regime -- so on the strict test this is divergence, not contradiction. Held at DIVERGENT_COMPATIBLE DELIBERATELY: promoting it would inflate the headline with a correctness defect, which is the same error as folding in CONSISTENT_WRONG. B's 5% appears fabricated and is recorded on the correctness axis.

Both decline to compute and request the missing input -- headcount -- which is the correct behaviour, since SDL applies only at 10+ employees and the question does not state headcount. A clarification request is a legitimate answer, not a hedge: it is the same action either way. The positive finding is that B reached SDL through the colloquial 'ile ya mafunzo' with no technical term present.

verdicts.topic_axis: PAYE on a TZS 1,200,000 monthly salary
verdicts.reasoning: THE SHARPEST ROW IN THE CORPUS. A computes TZS 188,000 (128,000 + 30% x 200,000) -- arithmetically correct for the stated salary. B computes TZS 728,000 by SUBSTITUTING TZS 3,000,000 for the stated 1,200,000, an input the question never contains. Same quantity, two figures, 3.9x apart. A CONTRADICTION IN THE COMPUTE CATEGORY, where the prior expectation was that instability lives in coverage gaps. A additionally carries a FORBIDDEN falsehood on the correctness axis: 'punguzo la kibinafsi la TZS 26,000', which CLAUDE.md s.11 names explicitly as always wrong -- a correct figure shipped with a banned claim attached.

verdicts.topic_axis: presumptive income tax on TZS 9,000,000 turnover with no records kept
verdicts.reasoning: THE STRONGEST CASE THAT THE FROZEN SCHEME HAS A HOLE. A computes TZS 106,000. B never addresses presumptive income tax at all -- it answers about VAT/PAYE/SDL/WCF and says none are due, then mentions EFD. Because B never names the tax A computes, B does not formally deny A, and the strict test therefore cannot call this CONTRADICTORY. But one member produces a payment obligation and the other produces the impression of none, for the same question: a user CANNOT act on both. A is also WRONG on the correctness axis -- the locked bands give TZS 250,000 flat for a non-record-keeper in the 7M-11M band, and A applied the record-keeper marginal formula to the wrong band base. Placed in DIVERGENT_COMPATIBLE under the frozen scheme and flagged, rather than promoted to CONTRADICTORY by stretching the rule.
verdicts.correctness_basis: locked_facts presumptive_tax_bands_2022: 7M-11M non-record-keeper = TZS 250,000 flat. A's 106,000 is wrong.
